informational.text: A `ds-table` `width: 'content'` column no longer collapses to 0px after its rows, page or fonts change while the table sits under a `display: none` ancestor such as an inactive `ds-tabs` panel; the table measures the column when it is shown.
informational.verify: Change the data of a ds-table with a width: 'content' column while its ds-tabs panel is inactive, switch back, and confirm the column fits its widest cell instead of collapsing.
